text:
evan: FYI ran into a deploy hold when SAST evidence uploads started failing after a maintenance sweep. KMS RPCs returned PERMISSION_DENIED for the scanner principal. blocking a bunch of rollouts.

kim: saw it. repo: service-auth. logs point to an IAM housekeeping job that removed a binding for scanner@. we need better drift detection. link: https://logs.internal/tx/70321-scanfail

zara: immediate fix was to restore a temporary decrypt grant via token-broker and requeue scans. that unblocked deploys. we should not make that manual every time.

maria: two parts: 1) detection and 2) safe fallback. detection = add a permission-drift dry-run in housekeeping that simulates key access for critical principals (scanner@, ingest@) and emits a warning if any lose decrypt rights. fallback = upload a tiny "provisional" artifact when decrypt fails so triage can continue.

ev an: +1. the provisional artifact should be auditable and short-lived. suggested fields: scan_id, repo, run_ts, error_code, provisional:true, backfill_required:true. also emit an alert when provisional artifacts are created.

kim: propose naming this pattern "evidence-vault-fallback". vault uploads must be gated: require SRE+sec and only enabled per org repo. retention 48h, auto-delete, and writes create a ticket in vuln-tracker labeled provisional-evidence.

zara: audit logging: include scan_run_id and rotation_tag in KMS request metadata and in the artifact metadata. CloudAudit should include these so we can join events. add a lightweight dashboard for PERMISSION_DENIED spikes by rotation_tag.

maria: token-broker behavior: broker issues short-lived decrypt tokens (ttl=180s) after OPA policy eval. rate-limit requests per principal: 3/min. broker must log {scan_id, requester, approver_type} in a structured audit stream.

kim: small GH Actions snippet to pass scan id and run a preflight check:

```yaml
env:
  SCAN_RUN: ${{ github.run_id }}-sast-${{ github.sha }}
steps:
  - name: kms preflight
    run: |
      curl -sS https://internal/ops/ci-preflight?scan_id=$SCAN_RUN | jq .ok
  - name: run scanner
    if: success()
    run: ./ci/run_scan.sh --run-id "$SCAN_RUN"
```

zara: preflight should attempt a tiny decrypt against the alias and assert CloudAudit log presence for that request. if preflight fails, block the release and page infra + sec.

ev an: action items: - evan: write drift-dryrun checklist + add to housekeeping job (ETA 48h) - kim: draft vault-fallback schema + retention policy (ETA EOD) - zara: add scan_run_id labels to KMS calls in scanner and ingestor (PR by tomorrow) - maria: start token-broker POC + OPA rule (POC 72h)

infra-bot: automated: created ticket SEC-70321-evidence-vault-fallback and scheduled canary check.

kim: one more idea: add a "role-change preview" webhook that emails owners when a housekeeping sweep intends to remove KMS decrypt from known principals. owners must acknowledge or the sweep is paused. prevents accidental sweeps.

zara: good. also add a nightly canary that verifies the entire ingest path (scanner -> KMS decrypt -> ingest) end-to-end. fail fast if any step regresses.

ev an: thanks. tagging sec lead @maria for visibility. (reactions: :warning: from zara, :thumbsup: from kim)
